items.title: Tanker hit by unknown projectile in Strait of Hormuz, fire extinguished, crew safe: UKMTO
items.title_zh: UKMTO：霍尔木兹油轮遭不明投射物击中，火灭船员安全
items.summary_zh: 阿拉比亚英文9月18日：英国海上贸易行动中心（UKMTO）称霍尔木兹一艘油轮遭不明投射物击中并起火，火势已灭、全体船员安全，环境影响未确认。与革命卫队宣称打击Trend的时间线重叠，但UKMTO未公布船名，独立核实是否同一事件仍缺。可见通航已极低的背景下，单次袭击足以强化“峡内仍危险”的保险与运费溢价。

quotes.author: Al Arabiya / UKMTO
quotes.en: The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations said on Friday a tanker was hit by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz, causing a fire that has since been extinguished, with all crew reported safe and the environmental impact unconfirmed.
quotes.zh: 英国海上贸易行动中心周五称，霍尔木兹海峡一艘油轮遭不明投射物击中并起火，火势已扑灭，全体船员安全，环境影响尚未确认。

items.title: Show HN: Radius – A Meetup.com Alternative
items.summary_zh: Radius试图做本地活动发现；首批评论嫌定位飘、把湾区用户钉到英国，并建议学Luma先深耕少数大城市垂直场景。73赞。

quotes.author: luckydata
quotes.en:
I have to say the site is quite bad, unfocused, disappointing essentially by design... I signed up and immediately pinned me in the UK (I'm in the Bay Area), it's called radius and ironically has no radius to limit groups around me...
I don't know exactly WHY this site should deserve the user's time.
quotes.zh: 站点相当糟、散焦、几乎故意令人失望……我注册后立刻被钉到英国（我在湾区），叫radius却没有限制周边小组的半径。不知道凭什么值得花时间。

quotes.author: dewey
quotes.en:
If you want to start in that niche you really need to double down on a specific subset of that niche to get people to use it. Right now you are not offering much over Facebook Events or Meetup and the tech / design in this case doesn't matter when all that matters is that you have people using it for their events.
I'd take a look at how Luma (The only seemingly competitor in that niche these days) is doing it, they are focused on a very small group of large cities and started being mostly for crypto related events. Only these days it feels like there's more variety in the events depending on the city. Doing a generic "I was annoyed with Meetup" strategy won't work.
quotes.zh: 要进这个赛道就得先死磕一个垂直细分。现在相对Facebook Events或Meetup没多出多少；技术和设计在这里不如“有人真的用来办活动”重要。看看Luma怎么做——先盯少数大城市。

items.title: 313,000 "Janfada" for Iran
items.title_zh: 伊朗德黑兰省举行31.3万人“坚法达”动员演练：民防后备扩编
items.summary_zh: 德黑兰时报/塔斯尼姆9月18日：德黑兰省举行约31.3万人“坚法达”（伊朗奉献者）动员，路线自伊玛目侯赛因广场至革命广场，含巴斯基、妇女与青年；巴斯基司令塔埃布称正把参与者编入防务单位，训练陆海空民防，并计划把后备模式推向全国约百万人，推动“防务与安全的民众化”。数字取什叶传统中马赫迪归来随从313之象征；分析指意在示威慑并凝聚亲政权群体。

quotes.author: Tehran Times
quotes.en: A 313,000-person "Janfada" exercise kicked off in Tehran Province, with Basij Organization Commander Hossein Taeb saying participants were being organized into defense units for ground, air and naval defense.
quotes.zh: 约31.3万人的“坚法达”演练在德黑兰省展开；巴斯基组织司令侯赛因·塔埃布称，参与者正被编入陆海空防务单位。

items.title: Resident Evil 4 (GameCube) – complete byte-identical decompilation to C/C++
items.title_zh: 《生化危机4》（GameCube）逐字节一致反编译完成
items.summary_zh: 项目宣称将GC版RE4反编译为可编译且字节一致的C/C++；评论质疑部分代码更像“行为仿真”而非恢复原编程结构，并提到依赖泄露调试符号对保存的意义。72赞。

quotes.author: groundzeros2015
quotes.zh: 我随机打开一个文件。这更像用可编译C语法仿真行为，而不是恢复游戏原本的程序结构——大片mot数组赋值……

quotes.author: wk_end
quotes.en:
From a preservation perspective, this is one of the least useful decomps ever, given how committed Capcom is to making sure RE4 is ported absolutely everywhere (kidding!)
Made using the leaked debug build and its symbols, which shows how meaningful the work the game preservation community that acquires and distributes these things is.
OTOH this is pretty off-putting:
> Where the compiler needed a particular source shape to reproduce a register choice or a schedule and no natural spelling was found, the construct is marked with a // COMPILER-DIFF: comment (644 of them: dead tests, empty asm("") launders and anchors, register T x asm("rN") pins, padding statements).
To me the value of a decomp isn't reproducing the original bytes per se (we already have the original bytes after all) - it's about reconstructing the understanding of the original game as represented by human-readable source code; getting byte-for-byte is just an indication that you've gotten it right. Needing to add a bunch of slop to force the compiler to match the original output is actually just an indication that you've gotten it wrong - and it's a demonstration of the danger of Goodhart's law, especially as it appl
quotes.zh: 从保存角度看，鉴于卡普空把RE4移植到了几乎所有平台，这反而是最没用的反编译之一（半开玩笑）。用了泄露调试版及其符号，说明获取分发这些材料的保存社区很重要。

items.title: Trying the Software Factory Pattern
items.summary_zh: Will Larson实验用代理流水线批量推进工程任务；评论称在僵化大企业里“高效”往往意味着绕开流程，并分享用语音+看板驱动代理刷issue的个人流水线。54赞。

quotes.author: hibikir
quotes.en:
Will has trouble with this in a relatively nimble org, where he has good control of what is adopted. Imagine how much fun this is in more ossified enterprise environments, where getting work done efficiently means bypassing process with dev lead and line management blessings. The differences in performance among individuals has never been wider, and not just gains in productivity, but performance losses as some people who have iffy judgement cause trouble a lot faster.
Maintaining quality when an organization just lacks the muscle to make changes and nobody has the mandate to try to make sure uptime is in good shape is a challenge.  A lot of things break, precisely because there's just as much change as Will sees, but it's very unevenly distriuted.
quotes.zh: Will在相对灵活、能主导采纳的组织里都吃力。想象更僵化的企业环境：真正高效意味着在开发负责人与线管默许下绕开流程。个体绩效差距从未如此大。

quotes.author: alexpotato
quotes.en:
So I ended up doing something similar:
- Create a Git Hub project board for issues
- Connect Grok to the above
- Use Grok voice mode to take ideas, have Grok refine them with me and then save them as issues
- Created slash commands in OpenCode like /ni (new issue), /do (do an issue), /curr (what is the current issue), /done (self explanatory)
- I generally tell the OpenCode instance to /do <number> and then off it goes
This give me several benefits:
- I can use Grok Voice while walking or driving to develop and test ideas
- I can lose my entire local OpenCode setup but still have relevant data in the issues
- multiple machines can read from GitHub
- I could go even further and have separate user accounts for each of my bots.
Having been both a PM, dev, SRE and manager, this really does feel like managing a team of devs.
quotes.zh: 我做了类似的事：GitHub项目板管issue，接Grok用语音边走边提炼想法入库，再在OpenCode里用/ni /do /curr /done斜杠命令让代理刷任务。

items.title: Italian frigate escorts Italian merchant vessel in Bab el-Mandeb
items.title_zh: 意护卫舰已在曼德为商船护航：Aspides框架下的即时动作

items.title: Nobody pays for FOSS, we can force them to
items.title_zh: 没人给开源付钱，我们可以强迫他们
items.summary_zh: Seldo长文讨论开源变现与注册表杠杆；评论欣赏Krita在Steam等商店售卖自动更新的双轨，也有人嫌全文LLM腔与“跳到注册表部分”的免责声明。51赞。

quotes.author: haunter
quotes.en:
I'm not sure it fits the free and/or libre software philosophy but I'm a big fan of releasing otherwise free and open source software as a paid version and with some exclusive QoL features in proprietary store fronts.
For example Krita. https://krita.org/en/download/ FOSS but you can buy it on Steam, Microsoft Store, Epic Store, and Apple Store. You get one exclusive feature, automatic updates (and more recently Steam Cloud sync support), and you also support the developers (on the other hand Valve, MS, Epic, and Apple also gets a cut too).
If you read for example the Steam reviews everyone points out that it's a free software but buying on Steam is also a good and very importantly straightforward way to support the devs + the platform itself has such a pull ("buying games you never play") that people buy it just for the case of having it in their library
https://store.steampowered.com/app/280680/Krita
quotes.zh: 不一定符合自由软件哲学，但我很喜欢把本可免费开源的软件在专有商店卖付费版并加独家便利功能——比如Krita在Steam/微软/Epic/苹果商店卖，换自动更新（以及最近的云同步）并资助开发。

quotes.author: dwedge
quotes.en:
> Now, finally, I have an idea. It's gonna take 5000 words to get there, though, so if you don't have that kind of time, skip to the part about registries.
This article is full of LLMisms, which is to be expected but maybe it wouldn't be 5000 words and wouldn't need this disclaimer if they wrote it themselves
quotes.zh: “终于有了想法，要五千字才讲到，没时间就跳到注册表那节”——满篇LLM腔。若自己写，也许用不着五千字，也用不着这句免责声明。

items.title: Trump weighs renewed major attacks on Iran: Report
items.title_zh: 联大前特朗普称临重大决定：歼灭政权或收手，先听海合会
items.summary_zh: 阿拉比亚英文9月18日援引Axios：特朗普称面临“重大决定”——是否恢复对伊朗大规模打击、甚至“歼灭”政权；拟在联大间隙会晤沙特、阿联酋、卡塔尔、科威特、阿曼等海湾领导人后再定。此前一日他还表示希望战争接近尾声。与民主党中期选举成本叙事、联大怀疑听众同日并置，外交窗口与再升级选项同台。

quotes.author: Al Arabiya / Axios
quotes.en: President Donald Trump told Axios he faces a "big decision" on whether to resume major attacks and "annihilate" Iran's regime, and plans to consult Gulf leaders on the sidelines of the UN General Assembly before deciding.
quotes.zh: 特朗普对Axios表示，他面临是否恢复大规模打击、甚至“歼灭”伊朗政权的“重大决定”，并计划在联大间隙征求海湾领导人意见后再定。

items.title: The Hierarchy of Money
items.summary_zh: Gregory Gundersen梳理货币层级与信任分层；金融从业者称像证书链一样清爽，也有读者觉得缺叙事主线、像AI拼段。48赞。

quotes.author: Wilsoniumite
quotes.en:
As someone who works at a financial institution, this is a really refreshing and concise breakdown of money and monetary systems. I think the most important thing that people should realise from reading this is that none of the things we have in our monetary systems were dreamed up for no reason, each solves a clear problem, and often was found by multiple independent groups of people at different times. I absolutely love the fact that it's essentially just layers of trust, analogous to a certificate authority or a domain name system.
And, of course, that the top level of trust is a bit arbitrary, and that "black money", of course the US Dollar, isn't worth more than trust in the US government.
quotes.zh: 作为金融机构从业者，这篇对货币与货币体系的拆解清爽简洁。最该带走的一点是：体系里没有一样是凭空空想，每层都解决明确问题，且常被不同群体独立发现。本质上就是信任分层，类似证书链。

quotes.author: hypfer
quotes.en:
I feel like this is either AI-generated or severely lacks context.
There might be a point in there, but it might also just be paragraphs of text with little structure joined together.
What's the narrative? What does this want to tell me? And why?
Something like an opening header block with 2-5 sentences would go a long way.
quotes.zh: 我觉得这要么是AI生成，要么严重缺上下文。也许有个论点，也可能只是结构松散的段落拼接。叙事是什么？想告诉我什么？为什么？开头用两三句话的提要会好很多。
